## About
TTS Auto Service is a family owned and operated repair shop on Old Pineville Rd in Charlotte, right across from Woodlawn Station. The business is run by brothers who took it over from their grandfather, and they run it as owner-operators.
We work on domestic and import cars, trucks and fleet vehicles, and we keep the waiting room clean and comfortable if you'd rather stay while we work. One reviewer called Justin patient, understanding and very kind.
Our neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 317 Google reviews. Give us a call or come by, and we'll tell you straight what your car needs.

## Services
- Car inspections: Vehicle inspections. One reviewer said they got in and out pretty quickly.
- Brake repair: We machine brake rotors in-house and repair drums, calipers, pads, shoes and brake lines.
- Engine repair: Complete engine repair, from tune-ups and timing belts to alternators and valve and piston work.
- Transmission repair: Transmission replacement and repair, plus filter and fluid service and transmission flushes.
- Oil change: Drop off your car for a lube service, oil filter and oil change.
- Tire service: Tire mounting, wheel balancing and tire repairs.
- Heating and air conditioning: AC troubleshooting, compressors, condensers, heater cores, radiators, hoses and fans.
- Alignment, shocks and struts: Front end alignment and shock and strut work.
- Fleet service: Scheduled and preventative maintenance for business cars, vans and trucks.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Appointments are our standard policy, so give us a call or schedule online before you come in.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We repair domestic and import vehicles from 1999 and newer.

Q: Is your labor warranted?
A: Yes. Our labor is warranted for 90 days. Ask us about specific products and what comes with them.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 am to 5:30 pm.

Q: Where are you located?
A: On Old Pineville Rd in Charlotte, across from Woodlawn Station.
